text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a full year of strength-centered training and bulking up, and Hishi Akebono has unlocked her massive frame's full potential.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time to get serious. Word has it that Biko Pegasus will run in the Sprinters S. Our next race is set.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The public seems more interested in their mismatched height difference than the race itself, but that doesn't bother Hishi Akebono at all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's confident that anyone who watches the race will be sucked into the excitement of it all and learn to love the race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our days preparing for the Sprinters S. and her battle against her all-important rival, Biko Pegasus, are starting in earnest!
